descriptionZh: 分步配置 Collection 元数据、NFT 身份和持有人；摘要由本地自动计算。包含四个 Covenant，仅用于 TN10 研究，普通部署保持禁用。
descriptionEn: Guided Collection metadata, NFT identity and owner setup with a locally computed digest. Four covenants are included for TN10 research; ordinary deployment remains disabled.
deploymentBlockedReason: KCC721 is a four-contract TN10 experimental pack; its dedicated independently reviewed genesis/mint builder is not included yet, so standalone deployment is disabled
requirementsEn: Research UTXO-native NFTs whose immutable identity and current owner are enforced by a live covenant lineage.

parameterSteps.titleZh: 集合与 NFT 元数据
parameterSteps.helpZh: 填写人类可读信息；Studio 会规范化 JSON 并在本地计算不可变 SHA-256。
parameterSteps.helpEn: Enter human-readable details; Studio canonicalizes the JSON and computes the immutable SHA-256 locally.

parameterSteps.helpZh: 新集合只能先做编译预览；已有集合必须粘贴从创世输出核验得到的 Covenant ID。
parameterSteps.helpEn: A new collection is compile-preview only; an existing collection requires a Covenant ID verified from its genesis output.

parameterSteps.titleZh: 持有人与 Cell 金额
parameterSteps.helpZh: 所有者使用 TN10 P2PK 钱包授权后续转移；Cell 金额不是 NFT 售价。
parameterSteps.helpEn: The owner authorizes later transfers with a TN10 P2PK wallet; cell value is not the NFT sale price.

parameters.helpZh: 摘要由以下内容确定，任何字符变化都会产生不同摘要。
parameters.helpEn: The digest is derived from these values; any character change produces a different digest.

options.labelZh: 导入已有 TN10 集合

parameters.helpZh: 编译预览使用内部全零哨兵且永远禁止部署；导入模式才接受真实 ID。
parameters.helpEn: Preview uses an internal all-zero sentinel and can never deploy; only import mode accepts a real ID.

parameters.placeholderZh: 64 位十六进制；从创世输出获得
parameters.placeholderEn: 64 hex characters from the genesis output
parameters.helpZh: 不能使用交易 ID、地址或随机构造值；新集合预览无需填写。
parameters.helpEn: Do not use a transaction ID, address, or invented value; leave blank for a new-collection preview.

parameters.helpZh: 必须在同一 Collection 内唯一，从 1 开始。
parameters.helpEn: Must be unique inside the Collection and starts at 1.

parameters.helpZh: 转移时通过通用 P2PK co-spend 授权组件签名。
parameters.helpEn: Transfers are authorized through the generic P2PK co-spend component.

parameters.helpZh: 至少 0.5 TKAS；这是 Covenant UTXO 承载金额，不是铸造价或售价。
parameters.helpEn: At least 0.5 TKAS; this is covenant UTXO value, not mint price or sale price.

invariants: Collection covenant ID is the canonical collection identity
NFT collection ID, token ID and metadata digest remain immutable across transfers
Every owner change requires a matching P2PK co-spend input
Batch transfers preserve one live successor per input covenant ID
Blind mint and migration proofs must be verified before creating an NFT genesis output

conservationChecks: every input maps to a unique successor
ticket template and genesis covenant binding verified

example.titleZh: TN10 原生 NFT 集合研究
example.scenarioZh: 开发者在 TN10 编译四个相互依赖的 Covenant，测试盲铸造、所有者 P2PK co-spend 和原子批量转移。
example.scenarioEn: A developer compiles four interdependent covenants on TN10 to test blind minting, owner P2PK co-spend and atomic batch transfers.
rolesZh: 部署者：固定集合参数和证明根
持有人：通过普通 P2PK 钱包授权
索引器：验证完整 Covenant lineage
rolesEn: Deployer: fixes collection parameters and proof roots
Holder: authorizes through a normal P2PK wallet
Indexer: validates the full covenant lineage
stepsZh: 完整编译四个固定提交的源码
使用专用 builder 创建 Controller 与 Ticket/NFT genesis
每次转移验证 Covenant ID、状态、金额和所有者输入
原子批量操作先计算真实 mass 再请求签名
stepsEn: Fully compile all four pinned sources
Use a dedicated builder for Controller and Ticket/NFT genesis
Verify covenant ID, state, value and owner input on every transfer
Calculate actual mass before requesting an atomic batch signature
example.resultZh: NFT 当前所有权由活跃 Covenant UTXO 表示，而不是仅由网站数据库声明。
example.resultEn: Current NFT ownership is represented by a live covenant UTXO rather than only a website database claim.
example.cautionZh: 这是社区 Draft 的 TN10 研究包，不是 KCC 正式标准，也未达到主网发布条件。
example.cautionEn: This is a TN10 research pack adapted from a community Draft, not a finalized KCC or a mainnet-ready release.
